soql_audit_query.description: Retrieve all field changes for a given AAR Record, most recent first
soql_audit_query.query: SELECT Id, Field, OldValue, NewValue, CreatedById, CreatedDate FROM AAR_Record__History WHERE ParentId = :aarRecordId ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC
